relationships.subject: platelets
relationships.evidence_quote: Platelets produce platelet growth factors such as PDGF, IGF-1, EGF-, HGF, TGFβ, bFGF, and VEGF, which are crucial in regulating all stages of the wound healing process.

key_findings: Review: platelet growth factors including VEGF in PRP/PRF support regeneration across dentistry, sports medicine, dermatology, gynecology, ophthalmology and neurology (including pain alleviation).
